title: Deterministic vs stochastic transition
description: In a deterministic environment an action has exactly one outcome; in a stochastic one it leads to a probability distribution over next states.
plainText: Deterministic: s' = RESULT(s, a); Stochastic: P(s'|s, a)

title: Normalisation of outcomes
description: In a stochastic environment the probabilities of all possible next states after an action must add up to one.

title: Vacuum world state count
description: With n squares, the agent has n possible locations and each square is clean or dirty, giving 8 states for the two-square world.

title: Size of the assignment space
description: A CSP with n variables each of domain size d has d^n complete assignments to search among.

title: Arc consistency condition
description: Arc X -> Y is consistent when every value of X has at least one supporting value in Y.
latex: \forall x \in D_X\ \exists y \in D_Y : C_{XY}(x, y)
plainText: for every x in D_X there exists y in D_Y satisfying C_XY

title: AC-3 and tree-CSP complexity
description: AC-3 on c binary constraints runs in O(c d^3), and a tree-structured CSP is solvable in time linear in n.
plainText: AC-3: O(c d^3); tree CSP: O(n d^2)

title: BFS complexity
description: BFS stores and generates every node down to the shallowest goal depth d.

title: DFS and IDS space
description: Depth-first methods store only the current path and its unexpanded siblings, so memory is linear in depth.

title: IDS node count
description: Nodes at depth i are regenerated d - i + 1 times, giving 123,450 nodes for b = 10 and d = 5.
plainText: N(IDS) = sum over i = 1..d of (d - i + 1) b^i

title: Bidirectional search
description: Two searches each reaching depth d/2 cost about 2 b^(d/2), far less than b^d.

title: A* evaluation function
description: A* ranks nodes by path cost so far plus estimated cost to the goal; greedy best-first uses h(n) alone.

title: Admissibility
description: An admissible heuristic never overestimates the true cheapest cost to reach a goal.

title: Consistency (monotonicity)
description: A consistent heuristic satisfies the triangle inequality, so f never decreases along a path.

title: Simulated annealing acceptance
description: Probability of accepting a worse move; it falls as the move gets worse or the temperature drops.
latex: P = e^{\Delta E / T} = e^{-|\Delta E| / T}

title: Minimax complexity
description: Minimax explores the whole game tree depth-first, so time is exponential in depth while memory is linear.

title: Alpha-beta best case
description: With perfect move ordering alpha-beta has an effective branching factor of sqrt(b), doubling the reachable depth.

title: Linear evaluation function
description: A heuristic score for a non-terminal position at the cutoff depth, built from weighted features such as material.

title: Implication equivalence
description: Removes implication for CNF conversion and gives the contrapositive form.
latex:
P ightarrow Q \equiv 
eg P \vee Q \equiv 
eg Q ightarrow 
eg P
plainText: P -> Q is equivalent to NOT P v Q and to NOT Q -> NOT P

title: De Morgan's laws
description: Moves negation inward across conjunction and disjunction.
latex:
eg(P \wedge Q) \equiv 
eg P \vee 
eg Q,\quad 
eg(P \vee Q) \equiv 
eg P \wedge 
eg Q
plainText: NOT(P AND Q) = NOT P OR NOT Q; NOT(P OR Q) = NOT P AND NOT Q

title: Resolution rule
description: Two clauses containing complementary literals yield a resolvent with that pair removed.
plainText: From P v Q and NOT Q v R infer P v R

title: Entailment by refutation
description: Justifies proving a goal by adding its negation and deriving the empty clause.
plainText: KB entails alpha if and only if KB AND NOT alpha is unsatisfiable

title: Quantifier negation
description: Pushing a negation past a quantifier flips it between universal and existential.
latex:
eg orall x\,P(x) \equiv \exists x\,
eg P(x),\qquad 
eg\exists x\,P(x) \equiv  orall x\,
eg P(x)
plainText: NOT forall x P(x) = exists x NOT P(x); NOT exists x P(x) = forall x NOT P(x)

title: Unifier definition
description: A unifier is a substitution that makes two expressions syntactically identical; the MGU is the least committed one.
plainText: UNIFY(p, q) = theta where SUBST(theta, p) = SUBST(theta, q)

title: Generalised modus ponens
description: Lifted modus ponens that applies a rule once θ unifies each premise with the known facts.
plainText: From p1'..pn' and (p1 AND .. AND pn -> q) infer SUBST(theta, q)

title: Skolemisation
description: Removes an existential quantifier by a Skolem function of the enclosing universal variables.
plainText: forall x exists y P(x, y) becomes forall x P(x, F(x))

title: Bayes' rule with total probability
description: Turns a likelihood and a prior into a posterior, with the evidence probability expanded over A and not A.
latex: P(A \mid B) = \dfrac{P(B \mid A)\,P(A)}{P(B \mid A)P(A) + P(B \mid \neg A)P(\neg A)}

title: Bayesian network joint distribution
description: Any full joint entry is the product of each node's CPT value given its parents.
plainText: P(x1, ..., xn) = product over i of P(xi | Parents(Xi))

title: Inference by enumeration
description: The posterior of a query is found by summing joint entries over hidden variables and normalising.
plainText: P(X | e) = alpha x sum over hidden y of P(X, e, y)

title: Conditional probability
description: Definition of conditional probability, from which the product rule and Bayes' rule follow.
plainText: P(a|b) = P(a AND b) / P(b), for P(b) > 0

title: Bigram probability (MLE)
description: Estimates the chance of a word given the previous word from counts in a corpus.

title: Bigram sentence probability
description: The chain rule with the Markov assumption scores how likely a whole sentence is under a bigram language model.

title: F1 score
description: Harmonic mean of precision and recall, used to evaluate NLP tasks such as named-entity recognition and classification.

title: Digital image storage
description: Storage for an uncompressed image of M rows and N columns with k bits per pixel; divide by 8 for bytes.
plainText: Size (bits) = M x N x k

title: Gradient magnitude for edges
description: Edge strength at a pixel from the horizontal and vertical Sobel gradients, used in segmentation.

title: Two-link arm forward kinematics
description: Gives the end-effector position of a planar two-link arm from its link lengths and joint angles.
latex: x = l_1\cos\theta_1 + l_2\cos(\theta_1+\theta_2),\ y = l_1\sin\theta_1 + l_2\sin(\theta_1+\theta_2)
plainText: x = l1 cos t1 + l2 cos(t1+t2), y = l1 sin t1 + l2 sin(t1+t2)

title: Gruebler mobility (planar)
description: Degrees of freedom of a planar mechanism with n links (including the ground), j1 one-DOF joints and j2 two-DOF joints.

title: Entropy
description: Impurity of a set of examples; 0 for a pure set and 1 bit for an even two-class split.

title: Information gain
description: Expected reduction in entropy from splitting on attribute A; ID3 splits on the attribute with the largest value.

title: Split information
description: Denominator of C4.5's gain ratio, large for attributes with many values, which penalises them.

title: Gini index
description: Alternative impurity measure used by CART; 0 for a pure set and 0.5 for an even two-class split.

title: Bayes' theorem
description: Converts the class-conditional likelihood and prior into the posterior probability of the class.
plainText: P(c | x) = P(x | c) P(c) / P(x)

title: Naive Bayes decision rule
description: Chooses the class with the largest prior times product of per-feature likelihoods, assuming conditional independence.
plainText: c_NB = argmax P(c) Π P(x_i | c)

title: Laplace smoothing
description: Adds one to every count so unseen feature values never get zero probability; k is the number of possible values.

title: Fuzzy AND, OR, NOT
description: Zadeh's standard operators for intersection, union and complement of fuzzy sets.
plainText: AND = min, OR = max, NOT = 1 − μ

title: Triangular membership
description: Membership rising from a to a peak of 1 at b and falling to 0 at c.
plainText: μ(x) = max(min((x − a)/(b − a), (c − x)/(c − b)), 0)

title: Discrete centroid
description: Centre-of-gravity defuzzification over sampled output values.
plainText: z* = Σ μ(z_i) z_i / Σ μ(z_i)

title: Sugeno weighted average
description: Crisp output of a Sugeno FIS, where w_i is each rule's firing strength and z_i its crisp consequent.
plainText: z = Σ w_i z_i / Σ w_i

title: Roulette-wheel probability
description: Chance that chromosome i is picked in one spin of fitness-proportionate selection.

title: Expected copies
description: Expected number of copies of chromosome i in a mating pool of size N under roulette selection.
plainText: n_i = N p_i = f_i / average fitness

title: Expected mutations
description: Average number of genes mutated per generation for population N, chromosome length L and mutation rate pm.
plainText: Expected bit flips = N × L × pm

title: Sigmoid and its derivative
description: The logistic sigmoid maps inputs to (0, 1) and its derivative is computed from its output.

title: Tanh and its derivative
description: Tanh is a zero-centred squashing function with range (−1, 1).

title: ReLU
description: ReLU passes positive inputs unchanged and outputs zero for negative inputs.

title: Softmax
description: Softmax turns K output scores into a probability distribution that sums to 1.

title: Perceptron learning rule
description: Weights change only when the thresholded output y differs from the target t.

title: Gradient descent step
description: Each weight moves against the gradient of the error, scaled by the learning rate.

title: Sum-of-squares error
description: The squared-error loss minimised by the delta rule and backpropagation; the ½ simplifies the derivative.

title: Delta rule
description: Gradient-descent weight update for a single differentiable unit; for a linear unit f' = 1 and y = net.
plainText: Delta w_i = eta (t - y) f'(net) x_i

title: Hebb rule
description: A weight grows in proportion to the product of pre-synaptic input and post-synaptic output.

title: LMS (Widrow–Hoff) rule
description: Adaline adjusts each weight in proportion to the error of its linear net input.

title: Adaline recall output
description: After training, Adaline outputs the bipolar sign of its linear net input.

title: Output-layer delta (sigmoid)
description: The error term of a sigmoid output unit is the output error times the sigmoid derivative.

title: Hidden-layer delta (sigmoid)
description: A hidden unit's error term is its sigmoid derivative times the weighted sum of downstream deltas.
plainText: delta_j = h_j(1 - h_j) sum_k w_jk delta_k

title: Backprop weight update
description: Each weight changes by learning rate times the receiving unit's delta times the sending unit's activation.

title: Momentum update
description: Momentum adds a fraction of the previous weight change to smooth and accelerate learning.
plainText: Delta w(t) = -eta dE/dw + alpha Delta w(t-1)

title: Hopfield weight storage
description: Weights are the sum of outer products of the stored bipolar patterns with the diagonal set to zero.

title: Hopfield energy
description: The energy never increases under asynchronous updates, so the network settles in a minimum.
plainText: E = -1/2 sum_i sum_j w_ij s_i s_j

title: Asynchronous update rule
description: One neuron at a time takes the sign of its net input from all other neurons.
plainText: s_i <- sgn(sum over j != i of w_ij s_j)

title: Storage capacity
description: A Hebbian Hopfield network of N neurons reliably stores about 0.138N random patterns.

title: A* evaluation
description: g is the path cost from the start to n and h the estimated cost from n to the goal.

title: Bayes' rule
description: Turns a likelihood and a prior into a posterior; P(B) comes from the law of total probability.

title: Entropy
description: Zero for a pure sample and 1 bit for an even two-class split; ID3 splits on the attribute with the largest gain.

title: Perceptron rule
description: Weights change only when the thresholded output y differs from the target t.

title: Sigmoid derivative
description: Used in backpropagation deltas; its maximum is 0.25 at x = 0.

title: Rational action
description: Acting rationally means choosing the action with the highest expected performance given what the agent has perceived and knows.
plainText: a* = argmax_a E[performance | percept sequence, knowledge]

title: Turing's prediction
description: Turing predicted that by about 2000 an average interrogator would have no more than a 70% chance of identifying the machine after five minutes of questioning.

title: Path cost
description: The cost of a path is the sum of the non-negative step costs of the actions along it.
plainText: g = sum of step costs c(s_i, a_i, s_i+1)

title: Nodes in a uniform search tree
description: Total nodes in a tree with branching factor b down to depth d, which grows as O(b^d).

title: 8-puzzle state count
description: Only half of the 9! tile arrangements are reachable from any given 8-puzzle start state.

title: Instance inheritance
description: An individual that belongs to a class also belongs to every superclass of that class.
plainText: instance(x, A) AND isa(A, B) -> instance(x, B)

title: IS-A transitivity
description: Subclass links chain upward, which is what lets properties propagate through a semantic net or frame hierarchy.
plainText: isa(A, B) AND isa(B, C) -> isa(A, C)

title: Default property inheritance
description: A member takes a class property value unless a more specific value overrides it.
plainText: instance(x, C) AND prop(C, p, v) AND NOT override(x, p) -> prop(x, p, v)

title: MYCIN certainty factor
description: Certainty factor as measure of belief minus measure of disbelief, ranging from -1 (definitely false) to +1 (definitely true).

title: Combining two positive CFs
description: Combines two rules that independently support the same hypothesis with positive certainty; the result never exceeds 1.

title: CF propagation through a rule
description: The certainty of a rule's conclusion is the rule's own CF times the weakest of its ANDed premises (max is used for ORed premises).

title: Classification accuracy
description: Fraction of test examples a classifier labels correctly, from the confusion-matrix counts.

title: Discounted return
description: The long-run reward a reinforcement-learning agent tries to maximise; γ close to 1 values future rewards more.

title: Mean squared error
description: Average squared difference between true and predicted values, the standard loss for regression.

title: Neuron output
description: An artificial neuron applies an activation function to the weighted sum of its inputs plus a bias.

title: McCulloch–Pitts threshold rule
description: A McCulloch–Pitts unit fires when its binary weighted input sum reaches the fixed threshold.
plainText: y = 1 if sum(w_i x_i) >= theta, else 0

title: Bias–threshold equivalence
description: A threshold θ can be replaced by a bias of −θ so that the neuron fires when net ≥ 0.
